d:
This studio's objective is to teach the language of Biblical Hebrew in the form of anime style video novels. The audio and speech bubbles will be in Hebrew, and the translations will be at the bottom in English. There will also be short animations that will focus on specific or special aspects of the language. Shalom Shama!

Why is this posted here?

Regardless of what platform, we aim to hear from as many people as permitted. All that will be provided here are the stories and artwork (both ai and sketch made) told in literature format. This will serve as a means to see the general reception of the stories' contents.
